setPieces.name: Welcome Room
setPieces.description: The dungeon's threadbare reception, dressed up for the cameras season after season: a moth-eaten red carpet, a sagging WELCOME banner, and three lifers who never got voted off — the Goon behind his welcome desk, the merchant hawking his table of wares, and the spell broker cornered by his overstuffed bookcase.

setPieces.name: Welcome Room v2
setPieces.description: Backstage holding area. Contestants discover the show's rules and choose a power before the dungeon swallows them. Clustered composition with diagonal weighting: living-corner chaos lower-left, spell-broker authority upper-right, merchant queue crossing the Z-path.
